shared_elements: low relief carving of figures in registers/rows
disc motif (rosettes in A, sun disc in B)
procession of figures moving in one direction
justification: Both show low-relief profile human figures arranged in a horizontal row and both include disc motifs (a rosette border in A, a winged disc in B), but that is about as generic as shared relief iconography gets. A depicts a narrative procession of men leading horned rams beneath a tree with a rosette dado, while B is dominated by dense rows of small script-like signs under a single small figural register with a curved top and adoration-type figures flanking, so the subject matter, scale relations and organisation of the surface differ fundamentally.
